title: Fix decimal tax rates for Polish region
summary: Fixed decimal tax rate validation in Polish region by replacing locale-sensitive parsing with invariant XML decimal handling.
key_points: Tax rate validation now uses XML-aware decimal parsing instead of locale-sensitive Evaluate method
Resolves error when entering decimal values like '10.4' in Polish regional format
Uses existing ScriptDataTypeMgmt.Text2Number method for consistent handling across regions
Applies to Tax Setup Matrix validation and decimal range field updates
